language_task: Put the toy strawberry into the pink bowl.
outcome_evidence: The robot acquires the strawberry and lifts it from the table in frames 49–68 (wrist_cam and right_base_cam), transports it over the pink bowl in frames 76–90, and releases it into the bowl in frames 91–97 (wrist_cam). Frames 100–115 show the strawberry remaining inside as the empty gripper withdraws. The bowl and other toys remain undisturbed through frame 240 (left_base_cam); no failed acquisition or harmful side effect is visible.
